verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents a first-party MCP integration. It lets coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code and Zed list services, run SQL and read monitoring over OAuth 2.1, so users can operate the database by prompting an agent. It also offers agent-drivable CHKit commands and isolated, logged agent compute. However, the natural-language layer lives in third-party agents, and the scope is limited to listing, querying and monitoring. missing for 10: a native natural-language or chat interface in the product itself, documented NL control of cluster management (resize, alerts, sharing) through the MCP tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
